```
override fun visitDocument(context: XmlContext, document: Document) {
    visitNode(context, document.documentElement ?: return)
}

private fun visitNode(context: XmlContext, node: Node) {
    if (node is Element) {
        node.attributes?.let { attrs ->
            for (i in 0 until attrs.length) {
                val attr = attrs.item(i) as Attr
                if (attr.value.needsXmlEscape()) {
                    context.report(ISSUE, attr, context.getLocation(attr), "...")
                }
            }
        }
        var child = node.firstChild
        while (child != null) {
            if (child.nodeType == Node.TEXT_NODE || child.nodeType == Node.CDATA_SECTION_NODE) {
                if (child.textContent.needsXmlEscape()) {
                    context.report(ISSUE, child, context.getLocation(child), "...")
                }
            } else if (child is Element) {
                visitNode(context, child)
            }
            child = child.nextSibling
        }
    }
}
```
